summary: An excerpt from a fiction manuscript (labeled Book 10, part 75) in which a character named Trish gives an younger colleague, Damian, advice about Washington DC's unwritten rules for office meetings. Trish explains that in DC any office-hours meeting carries a hidden purpose, read into its timing, attendees, and length, and that a meeting like Damian's invitation would be read as an attempt to parley or strike a deal before her bill goes to committee. The scene is set in a Capitol Hill office, where Trish watches a young staffer with a Naval Academy background on the phone.
one_line: In a Capitol Hill office, Trish advises Damian that every DC office-hours meeting is read as having a hidden purpose and deal-making intent.
key_facts: Trish watches a young man who looked like he had gone top in his class at the Naval Academy put his ankles up on the desk and tilt his chair while laughing on the phone.
Trish privately thinks the man on the phone is a key Congressman's aide, an old frat buddy of 'Mr Navy 2048'.
Damian says he is just learning as he goes and is trying not to make too many mistakes.
Trish's first lesson on the Hill was, 'If you're explaining -- you're losing.'
Trish says DC is a busy place where colleagues in academic and tech circles meet to feel out opponents, make acquaintances, or see old friends.
Trish says that in DC, people socialize after working hours, strictly on evenings and weekends.
Trish says a meeting scheduled during office hours always has a purpose, even if it appears to have none.
Trish says the unwritten protocol of meetings reveals purpose through the time, who attends, who is invited, who knows about it, the scheduled length, and whether food is catered.
Trish says that in any other city, looking someone up after arriving would make sense, but in DC a meeting like Damian's means he is looking to parley.
Trish says Damian wants to strike a deal before her bill goes to the committee.
Trish says she does not know how well Damian knows the Hill, so she does not want to impute motives to him.
Trish says she and Damian are still friends and that she thinks about him from time to time.
